decisions.design: One BCR/CD40 pair; GSM44051 through GSM44074 contain 24 arrays, four arms, two named Ramos(pinco) clones and three sample records per arm per clone.
decisions.limitations: Six nominal arrays per arm pool two clone states. Primary CD40 paper reports six independent experiments for its CD40 comparison, but does not establish six matched same-clone control/single/joint initiation blocks in this deposited panel. Dose, duration and initiation remain unresolved.

decisions.design: Eight yeast strains, including WT, HTZ1/SWR1/SWC2/SWC5 singles and three HTZ1-centered doubles; three reported independent biological repeats per strain.
decisions.limitations: GSM538774 through GSM538776 use different SWR1 strain identifiers. Strain equivalence and matched initiation need review under a yeast-specific contract; three repeats do not meet the original six-culture allocation.

decisions.design: Four Arabidopsis genotypes, four pooled carpel biological repeats each, one SEUSS/AINTEGUMENTA pair.
decisions.limitations: Each replicate pools 15 to 25 carpels; organ count is not independent RNA replication. Different organism and tissue contract, four repeats and one pair.
decisions.reason: pooled plant tissue and small graph

decisions.design: One doxorubicin/rapamycin pair across HB4a, C5.2 and SKBR3, five independent experiments per arm per line.
decisions.limitations: Source repeat labels are 1,2,3,4,6, not six repeats. Series specifies 20/30 nM doses, while sample protocol writes hM and calls combined treatment DRC although titles use DRC for controls and DR for joint. These contradictions need resolution.
decisions.reason: five repeats, different lines and protocol contradictions

decisions.design: Twenty-two neuro-ectodermal line identities, untreated and sequential DAC/TSA combined treatment.
decisions.limitations: No constituent single-treatment expression arms in the deposited panel; line identities are not independent same-state cultures.
decisions.reason: missing singles and changing cell states

decisions.design: Companion DNA methylation assay with untreated and combined DAC/TSA conditions.
decisions.limitations: This assay measures methylation rather than the original expression endpoint and does not repair the missing expression singles.

decisions.design: ZR-75-1 hormone panel, quadruplicate labels, three estrogen-centered nominal pairs plus an additional E2s/PROG group.
decisions.limitations: The shared protocol describes E2 and DHT only although titles also describe progesterone/MPA and E2s groups. Four repeats, unknown initiation blocks/vehicle fraction and unresolved extra-group dosing do not qualify the original bank.
decisions.reason: four repeats and incomplete treatment protocol

decisions.design: HL60 and TEX ATRA/TCP four-arm panels, three sample records per arm per line; six additional HL60 shRNA records.
decisions.limitations: ATRA doses differ by line (0.1 versus 1 micromolar), TCP is 10 micromolar and treatment lasts four days. Neither different lines nor shRNA samples create six cultures for the chemical pair.
decisions.reason: three repeats per state and one chemical pair

boundary: Published result narratives were encountered; no sample expression tables or matrix bodies were accessed in this follow-up.
